title: Google: Chinese state group is developing an automated attack tool for espionage
what_changed: Google's report says the PRC-nexus group was developing its own automated attack framework; it does not call it a version of ARTEX. The one-day PaperCut exploits were produced by security researchers and Huntress using LLMs, not by attackers. Plain-language note that Google's report could not be opened was removed.
